svg.title: Dollar Stakes at Each NEMT Foundation Gate
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-nemt-foundation-dollar-stakes; chapter number: 6; title: Dollar Stakes at Each NEMT Foundation Gate; subtitle: From launch capital down to the portal fee, every gate carries a price; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Wheelchair-accessible van launch; value: 50000; display: $30,000-$50,000 (ambulatory single van $15,000-$30,000); conversion: Launch capital sized before any enrollment filing; detail: Geoff Cole's all-in figures; Medicaid enrollment then opens a 60 to 120 day dead zone with no billing.; label: Missed state transport registration; value: 45000; display: $45,000 loss to one operator; conversion: Medicaid office and transport authority are separate doors; detail: Nemiton: enrollment is three separate layers; in California layer three is CPUC registration.; label: Unregistered operation fines; value: 25000; display: $5,000-$25,000 in fines plus shutdown; conversion: Registration filed and active before the first trip; detail: Nemiton: operating without CPUC registration earned a cease and desist after 3 months on the road.; label: Commercial auto premium; value: 10000; display: $6,000-$10,000 per vehicle per year; conversion: Bound before trips, defense kept outside the limits; detail: Brian Jungeberg on Medical Courier Connection; errors and omissions, not cargo coverage, protects a ruined biopsy.; label: NC Tracks portal fee; value: 631; display: $631 application fee; conversion: Portal link plus NPI required by most NC brokers; detail: Motivational Charles: most brokers contacted required NC Tracks linkage and an NPI before paying a provider.; caption: The LLC, EIN, Type 2 NPI, Medicaid enrollment and broker credentialing sequence, ranked by the dollars at stake at each gate.; assumptions note: Stage values use the upper bound of each quoted range; the $45,000 figure is a single operator's reported loss, not an average.; note: Sources - Geoff Cole (dLgmDQavyEU @ 00:05:52); Nemiton (qijT2a0o9VE @ 00:05:15); Medical Courier Connection (0eV-OzFHmX8 @ 00:05:40); Motivational Charles (pFLQ24hu-Ac @ 00:00:35).

text.title: Dollar Stakes at Each NEMT Foundation Gate
text.tspan: Dollar Stakes at Each NEMT Foundation Gate

rect.title: label: Wheelchair-accessible van launch; value: 50000; display: $30,000-$50,000 (ambulatory single van $15,000-$30,000); conversion: Launch capital sized before any enrollment filing; detail: Geoff Cole's all-in figures; Medicaid enrollment then opens a 60 to 120 day dead zone with no billing.

label: Missed state transport registration; value: 45000; display: $45,000 loss to one operator; conversion: Medicaid office and transport authority are separate doors; detail: Nemiton: enrollment is three separate layers; in California layer three is CPUC registration.

label: Unregistered operation fines; value: 25000; display: $5,000-$25,000 in fines plus shutdown; conversion: Registration filed and active before the first trip; detail: Nemiton: operating without CPUC registration earned a cease and desist after 3 months on the road.

label: Commercial auto premium; value: 10000; display: $6,000-$10,000 per vehicle per year; conversion: Bound before trips, defense kept outside the limits; detail: Brian Jungeberg on Medical Courier Connection; errors and omissions, not cargo coverage, protects a ruined biopsy.

label: NC Tracks portal fee; value: 631; display: $631 application fee; conversion: Portal link plus NPI required by most NC brokers; detail: Motivational Charles: most brokers contacted required NC Tracks linkage and an NPI before paying a provider.

text.title: Assumptions: Stage values use the upper bound of each quoted range; the $45,000 figure is a single operator's reported loss, not an average.
